Lavandeira Veterinary Clinic is where I found my peace. For 10 years living in another country, my cats suffered from a lack of quality professional care. One of my cats developed an illness due to poor diagnosis. Now, for the first time in 10 years, I've found a veterinarian I can trust. Dr. Erica is a very knowledgeable professional; by the second visit we already had the correct diagnosis, and my cat is being treated with great care, precision, and absolutely perfect service. Everyone at the clinic is very attentive, and you can feel that they love animals and what they do. My sick cat is undergoing treatment and responding very well, thanks to Dr. Erica's expertise. Christina
